headline: Marketing as a Service for Startups (2026 Guide)
image: [IMAGE: Marketing as a Service for Startups guide header]
description: Marketing as a service gives startups expert talent on demand — no agencies, no bad hires. Learn how MaaS works, what it costs, and how to choose.

mainEntity.name: What is marketing as a service (MaaS)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Marketing as a Service is a subscription-based model where businesses access vetted marketing experts on demand. Instead of hiring full-time staff, signing agency retainers, or managing freelancers, you pay monthly for dedicated specialists who work on your account. MaaS provides senior-level expertise with month-to-month flexibility.

mainEntity.name: How much does marketing as a service cost for a startup?

acceptedAnswer.text: MaaS costs for startups typically range from $5,000 to $30,000 per month. A single specialist runs $5-10K/month, while a fractional team of 3-4 specialists costs $15-30K/month. This is less than a full-time senior marketer's fully loaded cost of $120-180K annually and more flexible than agency retainers.

mainEntity.name: Is MaaS better than hiring an in-house marketing team?

acceptedAnswer.text: MaaS is better for startups that need speed and flexibility. You get a matched expert in 48 hours versus 3-6 months of recruiting. It's also lower risk — month-to-month commitment versus a six-figure hiring mistake. Once you've validated a channel and need full-time dedication, transitioning to in-house makes sense.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between MaaS and a marketing agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: MaaS gives you a dedicated senior specialist working on your account. Agencies typically spread junior staff across 10-15 clients. MaaS is month-to-month; agencies require 6-12 month contracts. MaaS specialists both execute and strategize; agency account managers often buffer you from the people doing the actual work.

mainEntity.name: How fast can a startup get started with MaaS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Top MaaS providers match startups with marketing experts within 48 hours. After matching, most engagements are productive within the first week. Compare that to 2-4 weeks for agency onboarding or 3-6 months for a full-time hire. MarketerHire's 95% trial-to-hire rate means the first match usually sticks.
